name: media-server-monorepo
description: Media Server monorepo containing server, admin, and client applications

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.start:dev: concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:client"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:admin
